name: Agent Guidance
description: Shares instruction files across selected agents without editing their workspace files.

directory.description: Absolute, operator-controlled directory outside agent-writable workspaces.

agents.label: Agent IDs
agents.help: Only these exact agent IDs receive guidance.

prepend.label: Prepend files
prepend.help: Relative files added before the system prompt. Reload after edits.

append.label: Append files
append.help: Relative files added after the system prompt. Reload after edits.

recommendedPrompts: Help me set up one shared instruction file for a few of my agents using Agent Guidance. Ask which agents and rules it should cover, then propose the operator-controlled file location and configuration. Preserve each agent’s existing workspace instructions and show the plan before changing anything.

Help me write a short shared working guide for my agents. Ask what behavior I want to make consistent, turn it into clear instructions, and distinguish shared rules from each agent’s own personality and memory. Show me the draft and proposed agent scope without applying or reloading it.
